verdict.rationale: The firm's own pages describe guiding companies "early through growth stage financings" and representing investors in "priced rounds, convertible instruments, and follow-on investments." The site also states deal volume: roughly 1,000 venture deals over two years, "thousands" of venture, growth equity, angel and PE investments a year, and a Dow Jones top-five ranking. Missing for 10: named representative transactions, explicit company-side coverage of seed through late-stage priced rounds (seed is never tied to financings), consistent deal-volume figures (1,000 over two years vs. thousands per year), and independent corroboration.
